text:
Jon: Hey all, Jon here — first day! Quick questions about devices and auth: can I use my iPad for light work (docs, Slack) or do we strictly require MDM enrollment for any device that accesses company email? Also curious about passkeys vs YubiKey — what do we recommend?
Maya (People Ops): Welcome Jon :tada: You can use personal tablets for read-only things but any device that accesses email or drives with company data needs MDM + device encryption. For a dev role we usually issue a laptop. If you prefer a laptop, file the hardware request form and mark it "dev new hire" — shipping in 2 business days.
Lina (Security): @Jon hi! Short summary: iPad for Slack/web ok if you don't add the company mail account. If you do, it must be enrolled in our MDM and have a passcode + device encryption enabled. For Macs, FileVault required. To check FileVault: ```fdesetup status``` — should say "FileVault is On." For iOS iPadOS we check MDM enrollment status in Settings > General > VPN & Device Management.
Jon: Thanks! For passkeys vs hardware tokens — is passkey (platform authenticators) acceptable for accessing CI/dashboard, or do engineers still need a physical key?
Lina (Security): We support passkeys for SSO for most staff, but engineering and anyone with infra or customer data access requires a phishing-resistant second factor like a FIDO2 hardware key (YubiKey) in addition to SSO. Passkeys are fine for non-privileged apps.
Jon: Got it. One more: are contractors automatically included in phishing sims? Im onboarding through GC and want to avoid being flagged for failing on day 2.
Devbench Bot: Note: contractors on shorter engagements are normally excluded from quarterly phishing pools unless they have access to internal tools. Check with your manager for an exception.
Maya (People Ops): If you're a contractor, tell your hiring manager to flag you as "onboarding-exempt" in the newjoiner form and cc people-ops. We can remove you from the simulation queue for your first two weeks.
security-bot: Automated message from security-bot: Phishing simulations come from simulation@redwood-security.test and include "[Redwood Sim]" in the subject. If you report it, you'll receive guided micro-training. Guidance: https://intranet.redwood.com/security/phishing-sims
Jon: Super helpful, thanks everyone. I'll request the laptop and pick up a YubiKey from ops.
Maya (People Ops): Welcome aboard again :rocket: ping us if you need the loaner expedited or have delivery constraints.
